# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- After implementing changes, always perform housekeeping needed for a current testing environment, then launch the app in the browser for the user to view.
- User wants implementation to proceed incrementally with alignment check-ins on the intent of each feature before moving to the next feature.
- User prefers plain white dropdowns with black text for usability in the SpiralWheel UI.
- User prefers to keep the current progression branch labels unchanged for now.

## Spiral Instrument Overlays
- For the new spiral instrument overlays, keep guitar and piano graphics display-only for now; defer custom scale editing/features to a later phase.
- When showing detected input pitch, use a separate connected-instrument widget rather than embedding the detected note in the virtual guitar UI.
